title: The Hatch
tagline: Find the way under Maple Street. The door downstairs charges rent in blood.

lootOnClear.name: Spare Key
lootOnClear.blurb: Cuts the Meter Room lock. Party stash.

rooms.title: Porch Light
rooms.narration: One porch bulb buzzes over a hatch that shouldn't be there. Paint peels. The lock is older than the house.

options.label: Force the hatch
options.successText: The frame splinters. You drop into damp concrete and the smell of old wiring.

options.label: Talk it open
options.successText: You argue with a door. It sighs and unlatches. Maple Street has rules.

options.label: Check the keyhole
options.successText: No key here — only a scratched mark: TOLL AHEAD. You still get through.

rooms.title: First Ladder
rooms.narration: Rungs slick with runoff. A wire runs taut across the third step — trap telegraph, not subtle.

action.prompt: How do you take the ladder?

options.label: Read the wire (check: Wit — Keen)
options.successText: You snip the trip. Trap dead. Keen would nod.
options.failText: Wire bites your shin — shallow cut. You keep climbing. Fail-forward.

options.label: Torch goes first (block the snap)
options.successText: The wire snaps on a shield edge. Noise, no blood. Down you go.

options.label: Rush the rungs
options.successText: Fast feet. The trap fires late into empty air.
options.failText: Trap tags a calf. You land hard, still on the map.

rooms.title: Toll Booth
rooms.narration: A window in the wall. No attendant. A plaque: ENERGY OR FLESH. The Concierge keeps books.

options.label: Agree: leave Energy for the toll
options.successText: Rule locked. Down here, unpaid tolls come out of hit points.

options.label: Argue the rate
options.successText: You shave a point off the debt. Concierge still collects.
options.failText: It stamps REJECTED. Same toll. Same door.

options.label: Walk past the plaque
options.successText: Fine. You learned nothing it won't teach with teeth.

rooms.title: Side Tunnel
rooms.narration: Service spur. Something small scrapes metal on metal. Cards out — first real fight.

action.prompt: Card combat — play allies, End turn to resolve

combat.prompt: Card combat — play allies, End turn to resolve

rooms.title: The Concierge
rooms.narration: A door with a ledger for a face. It reads your Energy. Unpaid tolls come due in HP.

action.prompt: Boss — watch the toll telegraph before you spend

combat.prompt: Boss — watch the toll telegraph before you spend

ending.title: Under Maple Street
ending.blurb: The hatch is open. The house above pretends nothing happened. Your party has a stamp — and, if you cleared it, a Spare Key.

wipeEnding.title: Wiped at the Door
wipeEnding.blurb: The Concierge closed the book. You climb out bruised. Recap the night. Try the Hatch again when you're ready.
